title: Хаб, протокол 2: envelope/ack, собственный pending ledger, retry full jitter, режимы buffered/durable, источники server/direct/Redis; v1 store удалён
summary: Хаб: `src/backend.js` (клиент v2: authenticate/load/append, HMAC, `X-Vaulter-Collab-Protocol: 2`), `src/retry.js` (full jitter base 100 мс/cap 2 с, ≤5 попыток, дедлайн 10 с, таймаут попытки 2 с, Retry-After в остатке дедлайна; retry только network/5xx/429), `src/ledger.js` (очередь на документ, независимая от onStoreDocument/debounce/destroy), `src/persistence.js` (stateless envelope → append → ack/nack; direct/server-origin → update_id хаба; Redis-origin не append-ится; load: replay checkpoint+tail), режимы buffered/durable и бюджет pending (stop writes всех rooms), status-сообщения; full-state `onStoreDocument` удалён. PHP: удалены маршрут `vaulter.v1.collaboration.hub.store`, `HubStoreController`, `PersistCollaborationStateAction`, `PersistCollaborationStateInput`; v2-маршруты требуют протокол 2.
why: D26: обычный Yjs sync не application ack; Hocuspocus 4.3.0 не повторяет failed store, destroy ждёт без дедлайна (закреплено P5.2). Hard risks: ack до backend commit; потеря server/direct-изменений (11); двойной append Redis-origin; новый update_id при повторе (1, 14); retry auth/validation/generation-ошибок; неограниченная очередь в buffered; failed append без нового изменения не повторяется (16).

rules: Ack клиенту — только после 200 append; ack содержит update_id клиента без изменения.
Повтор append — тот же update_id/sha256/payload; новых id при retry нет.
Retry только network/5xx/429; 4xx (кроме 429) и 409 epoch — без повтора; 409 epoch закрывает room 4409 и отбрасывает записи старой G.
Обновление с transaction origin Redis-расширения не попадает в ledger; direct/server-изменение — попадает ровно один раз.
sync step 1/2 и y-protocols update не дают ack и не переводят клиента в saved.
guidance: Мок backend — `http.createServer` на loopback-порту 0 в тесте, с программируемыми ответами (timeout, 500, 429+Retry-After, 409, 422). Время — инъекцией clock/sleep в retry.js (без реальных 10 с). origins.test.js: (a) `openDirectConnection().transact(...)` → один append origin=server; (b) `Y.applyUpdate(doc, u, redisExtensionOrigin)` → 0 append; (c) envelope клиента → один append с его id. ledger.test.js (16): append падает 500 до исчерпания дедлайна → nack retry:true, запись в ledger; без нового изменения следующий flush-цикл повторяет тот же id и получает ack.

result.notes:
Hub protocol 2: new src/backend.js (authenticate/load/append, HMAC, X-Vaulter-Collab-Protocol: 2; append makes one attempt and reports it), src/retry.js (full jitter base 100 ms/cap 2 s, ≤5 attempts, 10 s deadline including network time, 2 s per attempt, Retry-After within the remaining deadline, retries only network/5xx/429; time injectable), src/ledger.js (per-document FIFO queue independent of onStoreDocument/debounce/destroy; a record leaves only on 200; an exhausted series gives nack retry:true plus an error log and a failure count, the record is kept and the periodic flush cycle repeats it; 409 epoch drops the generation's records and closes the room 4409; 404 → 4404; 401/403 of a client record → close 4001/4403; server records are never dropped on credential errors; protocol mismatch keeps the record and raises a flag; running byte totals), src/persistence.js (stateless envelopes {t:u,v:2,g,id,h,b} validated, applied and appended under the client's id, ack {t:ack,id,seq,g} only after commit with the id echoed unchanged; nack codes; server/direct changes appended once under a hub uuid; Redis-origin and connection-origin sync updates never appended; load replays checkpoint+tail in seq order; an empty generation is seeded once as the log's first record via append with seed_state_version, reloaded on 409 seed_conflict; pending server records re-applied on reload; buffered budgets per room and total stop writes in every room; durable stops writes while the backend does not answer; status messages on connect and on every switch; serverWrite() returns after append in durable mode; state() for P5.9), src/rooms.js (close codes and helpers). src/index.js rewired without onStoreDocument; a client that does not announce protocol=2 is read-only. src/config.js adds VAULTER_COLLAB_MODE, PENDING_BUDGET_BYTES, PENDING_ROOM_BUDGET_BYTES, FLUSH_INTERVAL_MS, RETRY_* with validation. webhook.js removed. Pre-existing reds fixed on the spot (D43): core RouteListSnapshotTest's golden list lacked the P5.4/P5.5 routes (append, checkpoint, compaction.lease), so it had been red since P5.4; regenerated with UPDATE_GOLDEN=1. core SchemaSnapshotTest had been red since P5.4: the expected fixtures hold the collaboration tables, but the harness did not create them and the pre-P1.10 comparison did not exclude them. Both fixed. I found this by running the whole core sqlite suite once by mistake (an empty file filter), against the D45 rule on heavy runs; every other core partition passed.

Protocol addition chosen at detail level: append accepts an optional seed_state_version. The hub's seed of an empty generation is appended as the log's first record (origin server), and the backend refuses it with 409 collaboration_seed_conflict (the problem code is reused) once the generation has a record or a checkpoint, or the state version moved. Without it, removing the v1 store (seed=true plus state_version precondition) would have lost both protections: two hubs seeding at once (duplicated content) and a REST update between load and seed (silently overwritten by the next checkpoint). The protocol section's append body did not list the field.

Bug fixed along the way (D43 (4)): the P5.4 append path did not re-check the drive status under its locks, so an archive or deletion committed after CollaborationHub::open still let an append land; the v1 action checked it (assertUserWritable). UpdateLog::append now reads the drive status with a shared locking read under the drive lock that lock() takes (archived → 403 permission_denied, not active → 404), after the receipt lookup, so a committed retry still gets its receipt. HubDriveLifecycleTest proves it on sqlite; the pgsql liveness race tests were rewritten on append.

V7 as written was not run: vue discovery (npx vitest list) needs the npm registry, which the sandbox refuses (as in P5.4–P5.6). scripts/t baseline --compare -p core,media,drive,webhooks,documents,collaboration,azgard,filament,repo,hub exits 0. packages/vue/src/api/schema.d.ts was edited by hand in openapi-typescript's shape (store path/operation and HubLoaded/HubStored(Envelope) removed, required protocol header, seed_state_version), because api:generate and api:check could not run.

pending: Server-origin credentials: append requires a room JWT (ResolveCollaborationCall), and the design's 'subject in the body' for server appends does not exist in P5.4. A server/direct change is appended with the token serverWrite() names or its origin's context.token, else with the current token of a writer connected to this hub (or the serverToken option). With no such writer, the record waits in the ledger, logged once (no_credentials), until a writer connects or shutdown. Nothing is dropped, but nothing is persisted either.
